Container.Overview: DSH（DeepSeek Harness）是开源 AI 编码智能体：在浏览器里与它协作，读写你的项目、执行命令、管理模型与会话历史。本镜像为 Unraid 准备——自动跟随上游发版重建，内置命令沙箱所需的 bubblewrap，使它在没有 Landlock 的内核上也能正常执行命令，并集成 [dsh-remote-signin](https://github.com/2220545672/dsh-remote-signin) 插件：在局域网、Tailscale 或反向代理后面，用 DeepSeek 账号登录也能正常走完（只在最后多一步粘贴，粘贴框会自己出现在页面上）。 容器内置 Caddy 反向代理与可选口令门禁（也可设为 none 交给你现有的 SSO），以非 root 身份（PUID/PGID，默认 1000）运行。 | DSH (DeepSeek Harness) is an open-source AI coding agent you drive from the browser: it works on your projects, runs commands and keeps your session history. Built for Unraid — rebuilt automatically for every upstream release, with the bubblewrap sandbox bundled so commands work even on kernels without Landlock, and with the [dsh-remote-signin](https://github.com/2220545672/dsh-remote-signin) plugin integrated: a DeepSeek account sign-in also works over the LAN, Tailscale or behind a reverse proxy (it adds one paste, into a box that appears in the page). The container bundles its own reverse proxy and an optional password gate (or set none and delegate to your SSO), and runs unprivileged as a non-root uid (PUID/PGID, 1000 by default).
Container.Description:
DSH（DeepSeek Harness）是开源的编码智能体，界面就在浏览器里：它能读改你的项目文件、执行命令、管理模型与会话历史，工具与能力都通过插件扩展。
**为什么用这个镜像** - 自动跟随上游：镜像每天检查上游版本，一有新版本就构建、冒烟测试并推送；你只要在 Docker 页点一次更新，不用改任何配置。 - 命令沙箱真的能用：Unraid 内核没有启用 Landlock，DSH 的沙箱只剩 bubblewrap 一条腿。镜像内置 bubblewrap，模板默认带上它需要的两个启动参数，因此工具不会因为缺少沙箱而拒绝执行。 - 以非 root 身份运行（PUID / PGID，默认 1000:1000）、多架构（amd64 / arm64）、**默认开启内置口令门禁**：不填 **Password** 字段时容器会随机生成一个并打印在启动日志里（Docker 页 → 该容器 → Logs）。若前面已有反向代理 / SSO 做认证，把 **Authentication Mode** 改为 none。
**整体方案**：容器内置 Caddy 反向代理——对外只开你发布的那个端口，DSH 自身只监听回环，安全响应头、Host/Origin 校验与 `ALLOWED_CLIENTS` 白名单都在这一层完成。认证是可选的：默认 `builtin` 会像 Basic Auth 一样要一次口令（之后用 Cookie 保持，含 WebSocket 握手），设为 `none` 则交给前面的反向代理或 SSO——**不要叠两层登录**。容器以非 root 身份运行，不挂 docker socket，除你映射的两个卷外不碰宿主目录。
**运行身份（PUID / PGID）**：非 root 运行，具体身份由模板的 **PUID** / **PGID** 决定（默认 1000:1000）。Unraid 上 appdata 的属主通常是 `nobody:users`，所以**在 Unraid 上建议 PUID=99、PGID=100**；默认 1000:1000 适用于 compose / 通用部署。容器每次启动都会把 /data 与 /workspace 的属主交给这对值，改完重启即可。
**三步开始** 1. 安装并打开 http://<你的服务器IP>:8080 ：浏览器先弹出登录框，用户名 dsh，口令是 **Password** 字段的值——**模板自带默认值 12345678，请第一时间改成只有你知道的口令**（Docker 页 → 该容器 → Edit → 改 Password → Apply）。在改掉之前，同网络里知道这个公开默认值的人都能操作你的智能体。顺带说明：用户名字段默认 dsh，也可自行修改。登录后会自动完成令牌引导。想用随机口令而不是默认值，就改用 CLI 传 `-e DSH_PASSWORD=`（口令会打印在日志里，Docker 页 → 该容器 → Logs 找 GENERATED PASSWORD）。 2. 状态与项目分别放在 /data 与 /workspace（默认映射到 appdata/dsh/...），升级容器不会丢会话。 3. 放在反向代理之后时，把 PUBLIC_URL 设为对外地址（例如 https://dsh.example.com），容器就只接受该来源的请求；纯内网可留空。**若该代理本身已经做了认证（如 SWAG + Authelia），请把 **Authentication Mode** 改成 none**，否则会连着弹两次登录框。
模型凭据在应用界面里配置，本模板不要求填写任何密钥。
**用 DeepSeek 账号登录（而非 API Key）**：登录标签页最后会停在一个打不开的 `127.0.0.1` 页面上——这是上游的限制（平台只允许登录结果回到回环地址）。这时 DSH 页面右下角会**自动出现粘贴框**，把那个页面的地址复制进去即可完成登录；把本模板的 **Remote sign-in** 设为 off 可回到上游「只有回环地址下的浏览器能登录」的行为。镜像文档：https://github.com/2220545672/dsh-docker/blob/main/docs/remote-signin.zh-CN.md。
**页面提示 “dsh web authentication required”**：通常**自动**恢复（DSH 对文档请求回 401 时会被自动引到 `/renew` 重放启动 token，只绕一次、不会成环）；也可手动打开 `http://<你的地址>:<端口>/renew`，或清掉该站点的 Cookie。 **排障** - docker logs <容器名> | head -30 ：启动日志会写明运行模式（edge / lan）、上游版本与启动结果。 - 命令工具报 SANDBOX_UNAVAILABLE ：说明模板自带的 Extra Parameters 被删掉了，恢复那两个 --security-opt 即可。
上游项目：https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness · 文档与排障：https://github.com/2220545672/dsh-docker
--- DSH (DeepSeek Harness) is an open-source coding agent whose interface is a browser tab: it reads and edits your project files, runs commands, and manages models and session history, with everything extensible through plugins.
**Why this image** - Automatic updates: a daily upstream check rebuilds, smoke-tests and publishes whenever a new version lands. You just hit update in the Docker tab. - A command sandbox that actually works: Unraid kernels ship without Landlock, which leaves bubblewrap as the only rung for DSH's sandbox. bubblewrap is bundled and the template carries the two launch options it needs, so commands never refuse to run for lack of isolation. - Runs as non-root (PUID / PGID, default 1000:1000), multi-arch (amd64 / arm64), and **serves its own password gate by default**: leave **Password** empty and the container generates one and prints it once in the startup log (Docker tab -> the container -> Logs). If a reverse proxy or SSO already authenticates, set **Authentication Mode** to none.
**How it is put together**: the container bundles Caddy as its reverse proxy — the port you publish is the only way in, DSH itself listens on loopback only, and the security headers, host/origin checks and the `ALLOWED_CLIENTS` allowlist all happen at that layer. Authentication is optional: `builtin` (the default) asks for a password once, like basic auth, and then keeps you signed in with a cookie that also covers the WebSocket handshake; `none` hands that job to your own reverse proxy or SSO — do not stack two logins. The container runs unprivileged, mounts no docker socket, and touches no host directory beyond the two volumes you map.
**The identity it runs as (PUID / PGID)**: it runs unprivileged, as the **PUID** / **PGID** the template sets (1000:1000 by default). Unraid appdata is normally owned by `nobody:users`, so **on Unraid set PUID=99 and PGID=100**; the 1000:1000 default is for compose and other generic deployments. At every start the container hands /data and /workspace over to that pair, so a change needs only a restart.
**Get started in three steps** 1. Install, then open http://<your-server>:8080 — the browser asks for a login first: user dsh, password from the **Password** field (`DSH_PASSWORD`). **The template ships 12345678 as a default: change it to something only you know before you go further** (Docker tab -> the container -> Edit -> Password -> Apply). Until you do, anybody on your network who knows this public default can drive the agent. The user name field defaults to dsh and can be changed. The token bootstrap then completes automatically. If you prefer a random password over the default, run the container from the CLI with an explicitly empty `-e DSH_PASSWORD=` instead (it is printed once in the log: Docker tab -> the container -> Logs, look for GENERATED PASSWORD). 2. State and projects live in /data and /workspace (mapped to appdata/dsh/... by default), so upgrading the container keeps your sessions. 3. Behind a reverse proxy, set PUBLIC_URL to the public origin (for example https://dsh.example.com) so the container only answers for that authority; leave it empty on a trusted LAN. If that proxy already authenticates (SWAG + Authelia, Authentik, ...), also set **Authentication Mode** (`AUTH_MODE`) to none so the browser is not asked to log in twice.
Model credentials are configured inside the app; this template never asks for a key.
**Signing in with a DeepSeek account (rather than an API key)**: the login tab ends on a dead `127.0.0.1` page — that is upstream's restriction (the platform only returns a login to a loopback address). A paste panel appears in the DSH page by itself; drop that address into it (the paste box appears in the page by itself). Set **Remote sign-in** to off for upstream's loopback-only behaviour. Repository documentation: https://github.com/2220545672/dsh-docker/blob/main/docs/remote-signin.md.
**Page says “dsh web authentication required”**: it now recovers **automatically** (a 401 on the document is redirected through `/renew`, once, without looping); you can also open `http://<your-address>:<port>/renew` yourself or clear that site's cookies. **Troubleshooting** - docker logs <container> | head -30 — the entrypoint prints the mode (edge / lan), the upstream version and the startup result. - Tools reporting SANDBOX_UNAVAILABLE mean the template's Extra Parameters were removed; restore the two --security-opt values.
Upstream project: https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness · Documentation and troubleshooting: https://github.com/2220545672/dsh-docker

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: DeepSeek Harness Web UI 的宿主侧绑定，格式必须是 IP:端口（Unraid 会把裸端口号误解析成 IP，容器会卡在 Created）。容器内端口固定为 8080；想只让本机访问就改成 127.0.0.1:8080，暴露范围请配合 **Allowed Clients** 一起收紧。| Host-side binding, and it MUST be written as IP:port — Unraid mis-parses a bare port number as an IP and the container stays in Created. The container port is always 8080; use 127.0.0.1:8080 to expose it on the loopback only.

Config.Name: Data Directory
Config.Description: DSH_HOME：会话、凭据、agent home（/data/dsh）与 Caddy 状态。必须是持久化目录，否则重建容器即丢失全部会话。DSH_HOME (sessions, credentials, agents) plus Caddy state; keep it persistent.

Config.Name: Workspace Directory
Config.Description: 智能体的工作目录（DSH_WORKSPACE），容器启动即 cd 到此。宿主机上建议放需要长期保留的项目。The agent's working directory; the container cd's here at start.容器内也可用 ~/workspace 访问，目录选择器默认就落在这里。Also reachable inside the container as ~/workspace, where the directory picker starts.

Config.Name: PUID (default: 1000)
Config.Description: DSH 进程与它派生的所有进程（命令工具、插件）以哪个 uid 运行。Unraid 上 appdata 的常规属主是 nobody:users，所以 **Unraid 用户建议填 99**；默认值 1000 面向 compose / 通用部署。容器启动时会把 /data 与 /workspace 的属主交给 PUID:PGID，所以改完重启即可，不必手工 chown。PUID 不能为 0。| The uid DSH and every process it spawns (commands, plugins) run as. Unraid appdata is normally owned by nobody:users, so **set 99 on Unraid**; the 1000 default is for compose and other generic deployments. At every start the container hands /data and /workspace over to PUID:PGID, so a change needs only a restart — no manual chown. PUID must not be 0.

Config.Name: PGID (default: 1000)
Config.Description: DSH 进程与它派生的所有进程以哪个 gid 运行。Unraid 上 appdata 的常规属主是 nobody:users，所以 **Unraid 用户建议填 100**；默认值 1000 面向 compose / 通用部署。容器启动时会把 /data 与 /workspace 的属主交给 PUID:PGID，所以改完重启即可，不必手工 chown。PGID 不能为 0。| The gid DSH and every process it spawns runs as. Unraid appdata is normally owned by nobody:users, so **set 100 on Unraid**; the 1000 default is for compose and other generic deployments. At every start the container hands /data and /workspace over to PUID:PGID, so a change needs only a restart — no manual chown. PGID must not be 0.

Config.Name: Allowed Clients (IP / hostname)
Config.Description: 只允许这些来源访问界面，逗号分隔。**IP 或 CIDR** 按连接来源地址匹配；**域名**按 Host 头匹配。模板默认已放宽到私有网段（RFC1918 + 链路本地 + Tailscale CGNAT），装完即可从局域网/Tailscale 打开，公网仍进不来——因为公网来源不属于任何一条；想收紧就把多余的网段删掉，只留你自己的。**镜像本身的默认值是严格的 127.0.0.1**（只允许本机），模板只是替你放宽到「不会被公网碰到」的范围。填域名时浏览器必须用该域名访问（经代理时域名应为 PUBLIC_URL 的主机名）。| Only these clients may reach the UI, comma separated: IPs/CIDRs match the peer address, hostnames match the Host header. The default 127.0.0.1 means localhost only (loopback is always allowed because the container's own healthcheck needs it). Add your LAN subnet, or your reverse proxy's address, when something else must connect.

Config.Name: Username (default: dsh)
Config.Description: 登录框里的用户名（**默认 dsh**，必填）。改这里等于换用户名；浏览器会记住旧的用户名/口令组合，改完请清理已保存的登录信息。| User name for the built-in gate (default dsh, required). The browser remembers the old pair, so clear the saved login after changing it.

Config.Name: Password (default: 12345678 — change it)
Config.Description: ⚠️ **模板自带默认口令 12345678，请务必改成只有你知道的口令**（改完点 Apply 重建容器即生效；默认值 12345678 以圆点显示，改了它浏览器下次就会用新口令）。这是容器自带门禁（Authentication Mode = builtin）的唯一口令；在改掉之前，任何能访问这个端口、且知道这个公开默认值的人都能操作你的智能体（可在你的项目里执行命令、读取 /data 里的凭据）。在界面上它以圆点显示（Mask 只影响显示，值会照常传给容器）；清空内容 = 用回默认值 12345678；想改成随机口令请在 CLI/compose 里显式传空 `-e DSH_PASSWORD=`（首启生成并打印一次）。口令至少 8 位、不能含空白字符；改口令会让此前签发的登录 Cookie 全部失效。Password for the built-in gate. The template ships 12345678 as a default — change it before you go further; until then anybody who can reach the port and knows this public default can drive the agent. It shows as dots in the GUI (Mask is display only; the value still reaches the container); clearing it falls back to the default 12345678; for a random one pass an explicitly empty `-e DSH_PASSWORD=` from the CLI/compose (generated on first start and printed once). At least 8 characters, no whitespace.

Config.Name: Authentication Mode
Config.Description: builtin（默认）= 容器自带口令门禁，适合直接给内网使用或经端口转发远程访问；none = 不使用自带认证，把鉴权交给前面的反向代理 / SSO（如 SWAG + Authelia）或受信内网。其它取值会让容器拒绝启动。注意：口令走明文 HTTP 时可被监听，公网访问仍必须由反向代理提供 HTTPS。builtin serves the container's own password gate (default); none delegates to an authenticating proxy or a trusted LAN. Other values fail closed. A password over plain HTTP is sniffable, so internet exposure still needs a TLS reverse proxy.

Config.Name: Trusted Proxy CIDRs (optional)
Config.Description: 仅当容器前面有反向代理时填写：Caddy 只对这些来源读取 X-Forwarded-For，从而按**真实客户端 IP** 匹配 **Allowed Clients**。切勿填写不可信客户端也能发起的网段——那样任何人都能伪造来源绕过白名单。| Only when a reverse proxy fronts this container: Caddy then reads X-Forwarded-For from these peers only, so the allowlist sees the real client address. Never list a range untrusted clients can originate from; they could forge the header and bypass the allowlist.

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: 对外访问地址的完整 origin，例如 https://dsh.example.com（不要带路径）。设置后会启用严格模式：DSH 只接受该 authority 的请求，并拒绝其它 Origin。留空 = 局域网模式：仅剥掉 Origin 并把 Host 固定为 loopback，适合受信内网或 VPN。Full origin when a reverse proxy fronts this container; leave empty for a trusted LAN.

Config.Name: Trusted Hosts (DSH_TRUSTED_HOSTS)
Config.Description: 额外的可信 authority，逗号分隔（如 dsh.example.com,192.168.1.10:8080）。仅在设置了 PUBLIC_URL 时生效。Extra accepted host[:port] authorities, comma separated; only used together with PUBLIC_URL.

Config.Name: Remote Sign-in (default: on)
Config.Description: 用 DeepSeek **账号**（而不是 API Key）登录时：on（默认）会加载 dsh-remote-signin 插件，让局域网 / Tailscale / 反向代理后面的浏览器也能把登录走完——登录标签页最后停在打不开的 127.0.0.1 页面上，此时 DSH 页面里会自动出现粘贴框；off = 上游行为（只有回环地址下的浏览器能用账号登录）。填其它值容器拒绝启动。| DeepSeek **account** sign-in (as opposed to an API key): on (default) loads the dsh-remote-signin plugin so a browser on the LAN, Tailscale or behind a proxy can finish the login — the login tab ends on a dead 127.0.0.1 page and a paste panel appears in the page itself; off = upstream behaviour (only a loopback browser can sign in with an account). Any other value refuses to start.
